description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode, +500 ATK & +500 MAG to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Dark Ability Boost, Triplecast Dark, Unlimited Dark Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Dark Abilities, Dark Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Dark Abilities; Ends after using 8 Dark abilities
TP Max: AOE Dark/NE ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1

description.name: War-Awoken Hellish Kick (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Dark/NE piercing ranged hybrid attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Dark Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/2 En-Dark members
WS Gold: Dualcast Dark 3, Instant Dark 3 & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Blue: Dualcast Dark 2, Instant Dark 2 & Weakness Damage +30% for 2 turns to all allies
